name: org.dpppt.android.sdk.internal.BootCompletedBroadcastReceiver
description: When Android starts the device or replaces the host app after an update, the DP3T Android exposure-tracing SDK restarts background synchronization and broadcasts updated tracing status if tracing was initialized and enabled.
disableEffect: DP3T would not restart its sync worker on boot or after an app update, so exposure status might stop refreshing in the background.
